newsitem.title: USA: United American Q2 net up on cost controls.
newsitem.headline: United American Q2 net up on cost controls.

text.p: United American Healthcare Corp said Monday a focus on cost control and more marketing of its services helped the company post a profit in the second quarter ended December 31.

The company reported earnings of $114,306, or $0.02 a share, versus a loss of $2.3 million, or $0.35 a share, one year ago. The year-ago figure also included income taxes of $3.5 million amd a loss before income tax expense of $5.8 million, the company said.
United American provides health care management services.
Its shares were trading up 3/8 Monday at 4-7/8.
